summary: Liberty Defense Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 6, 2026, announcing commercial product selections rather than a special situation. HEXWAVE was chosen by one of the largest state court systems and a state department of corrections, covering four units to be deployed over the next few months; no financial terms, stake, price per share, premium or close date were disclosed. The court program is a first phase that could expand to additional facilities, while the corrections award spans three facilities. Management framed the awards as validation of vertical-market focus. This remains an ordinary operational update, not a deal, tender, restructuring or management change; no risk-arb angle applies.
